entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included in messages when the network wishes to transmit protocol data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events) to the UE. It is used when extended protocol configuration options are supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Protocol data transmission to UE
entities.description: Procedure where the network transmits protocol data (configuration parameters, error codes, messages/events) to the UE using extended protocol configuration options.

entities.name: Extended PCO supported end-to-end
entities.description: Condition that extended protocol configuration options are supported by both the UE and the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

relations.description: The protocol data transmission procedure uses the extended protocol configuration options IE to carry data to the UE.
The protocol data transmission procedure using extended PCO is only performed when extended protocol configuration options are supported by both UE and network end-to-end.
